pages.title: Request a panel place
pages.content:
Four panel places open in April 2027. Requests join the waitlist in the order received. Email desk@satei-adjusters.example with your firm's name, the lines of business you instruct on, and the regions you cover. We reply within one working day (Mon–Fri 08:00–18:00).

Joining the waitlist is not a commitment on either side. When a place opens we send our terms of appointment and the fee schedule for review, and agree a trial instruction before the place is confirmed.

pages.title: Thank you
pages.content:
Thank you. Your request for a panel place is on the waitlist and our Bristol desk will reply within one working day.

In the meantime you are welcome to read how a visit runs and what each fee covers on the home page.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
This page explains what personal information Satei Adjusters (a fictional business used for a theme demonstration) collects through this website and why.

What we collect

When you email the desk we keep your name, firm, email address and the content of your message. The website itself sets no advertising or tracking cookies.

How we use it

We use your details only to answer your request and to manage the waitlist. We do not sell them and do not share them with third parties other than service providers who host our email.

How long we keep it

Waitlist requests are deleted twelve months after the last contact unless you become an appointed panel member.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold by emailing desk@satei-adjusters.example.

pages.title: Terms
pages.content:
These terms apply to your use of this website. Satei Adjusters is a fictional business used for a theme demonstration.

Information on this site

Descriptions of services, response times and fees are given for general information and do not form an offer. Terms of appointment are agreed in writing with each insurer before any instruction.

Waitlist

A waitlist request does not guarantee a panel place. Places are offered in the order requests are received, subject to the desk's capacity.

Liability

We take care that the content of this site is accurate, but we accept no liability for decisions made in reliance on it.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales.
